title: Electrical measurements
description: Measurements are carried out by persons holding the appropriate SEP qualifications, using calibrated equipment

items: Electrical shock protection: Checking the effectiveness of protection (e.g. residual current devices) to ensure users are not electrocuted.
Fire safety: Checking insulation and connections to prevent short circuits and fires.
Compliance with legal regulations: A statutory requirement (Section 62 of the Building Act), which stipulates that inspections must be carried out at least once every 5 years.
Fault detection: Early detection of faults in the installation before they lead to costly repairs.
Verification of new installations: Checking that a newly installed system is functioning correctly and is safe.

blocks.text: Who performs the measurements and using what equipment?
Measurements are carried out by persons holding the appropriate SEP qualifications, using calibrated equipment
Verified equipment, to ensure visual inspection capability, is marked with a sticker.
